title: Speccy profile
description: The configuration for one doc type: template, limits, links, trace IDs, waivers, approvals, divergence, lint, and checks.

key.description: The doc type. A spec doc's frontmatter type, or a map entry in .speccy.yaml, selects the profile with this key.

name.description: The name the app shows for this doc type, such as Product Requirements Document.

version.description: Speccy sets it on each save. Earlier review runs keep the version they used.

template.description: The path of the template, relative to the profile file. A doc must have each heading that ends with `<!-- required -->`, or with `<!-- required: app -->` at size app and larger (`lint.required-headings`).

limits.description: The size limits that lint checks. A key you leave out keeps its default.

max_words.description: The most words in the doc (`lint.prose-limit`). Default 8000.

max_section_words.description: The most words in one section (`lint.prose-limit`). Default 900.

max_sentence_words.description: The most words in one sentence (`lint.sentence-length`). Default 25.

max_code_block_lines.description: The most lines in one code block (`lint.asset-nudge`). Default 40.

max_table_rows.description: The most rows in one table (`lint.asset-nudge`). Default 15.

links.description: The links a doc of this type must have.

upstream.description: The upstream link that a doc of this type needs (`links.has-upstream`).

kinds.description: The link kinds that count as an upstream link.

types.description: The profile keys that an upstream doc can have, such as prd.

required.description: When true, a doc with no upstream link and no standalone acknowledgement fails `links.has-upstream`. Default false.

children.description: A doc at size min_at or larger must link the bundles it covers (`links.has-children`).

kinds.description: The link kinds that count as a link to a covered bundle.

min.description: The fewest links of those kinds that the doc needs.

min_at.description: The smallest doc size that the check applies to.

grounding.description: The settings of the grounding stage.

sources.description: The source policy: which domains the grounding stage accepts, their tier, their freshness period, and the claim class of a section.

allow.description: When the list has a host, the grounding stage accepts sources from these hosts only.

forbid.description: Hosts that Speccy never accepts and never requests.

domains.description: The tier of each host pattern. A host that matches no pattern is secondary.

tier.description: The tier of a host that matches the pattern. The most specific pattern wins.

freshness.description: Days a source of that tier stays usable. Zero is no limit.

primary.description: Days a primary source stays usable.

secondary.description: Days a secondary source stays usable.

require_primary.description: The claim classes whose sources must all be primary.

classes.description: Rules that give the claims of a section a claim class, by heading path. The most specific pattern wins.

pattern.description: A heading path, with / between headings. A `*` segment matches one heading, and a trailing `**` matches the rest. The match ignores case.

class.description: The claim class of a section that matches the pattern. The name `unclassified` is not a valid class.

unclassified.description: What Speccy does with a claim in a section that matches no class rule. `allow` does nothing, and `warn` adds a note to the run. `require-classification` drops the claim's sources. Default `allow`.

verify.description: The post-build verification gate: the trace IDs it verifies, and the bounds of its repo scan.

prefixes.description: The trace ID prefixes that a verification run checks. Default REQ and NFR.

exclude.description: Path globs that the repo scan passes over. A list you set replaces the default, which holds `vendor/**`, `node_modules/**`, `dist/**`, `build/**`, `.git/**`, `**/testdata/**`, `**/*.min.js`, `**/*.lock` and `**/*.sum`.

max_file_kb.description: The largest file, in KB, that the repo scan reads. Default 512.

max_mapper_files.description: The most files that the model which finds code targets sees, highest ranked first. Default 200.

trace.description: The trace IDs of this doc type.

prefixes.description: The trace ID prefixes that this doc type defines. An ID with another prefix gets `trace.unknown-prefix`.

cover.description: The prefixes of upstream IDs that this doc must cover. Each such ID in an implements target needs a reference or an acknowledgement (`trace.coverage`).

waivers.description: Who approves a waiver, by the level of the check.

should.description: The waiver policy of a SHOULD check. Default non_author.

must.description: The waiver policy of a MUST check. Default maintainer.

approvals.description: The approvals that a spec doc of this type needs.

required.description: How many approvals the current version needs. Default 1.

divergence.description: The divergence stage: its readers and its build questions.

readers.description: How many readers answer the build questions. Default 3.

questions.description: How many build questions the stage writes.

min.description: The fewest build questions. Default 10. It cannot be larger than max.

themes.description: The topics that the build questions cover, such as error handling or limits.

lint.description: The settings of the lint stage.

overrides.description: A level for a lint check, by slug: MUST, SHOULD, INFO, or off. The value off turns the check off.

level.description: The level of the check, or off.

slop_extra.description: More filler phrases for `lint.slop-phrase` to find, on top of its own list.

checks.description: The checks that a review runs besides lint. Each check has a slug, a level and a stage.

slug.description: The ID of the check: lower-case words with dots between them, such as `sdd.data-model`. It is unique in the profile.

level.description: The level of a finding. An open MUST finding makes the verdict Not Build Ready.

stage.description: The review stage that runs the check.

scope.description: What the check reads. With doc, a waiver covers the whole doc. With section, a waiver covers one section. Default doc.

question.description: The question the check asks about the doc.

pass_when.description: What must hold for the check to pass. A finding gives it as the fix.

waiver.description: Who approves a waiver of this check. It replaces `waivers.should` or `waivers.must` for this check.

sizes.description: The doc sizes this check applies to. An empty list applies at every size.

hostPattern.description: A host, such as `example.com`, or `*.example.com` for its subdomains.

prefix.description: A trace ID prefix: two to six capital letters, such as REQ.

lintSlug.description: The slug of a lint check.

waiverPolicy.description: Who approves a waiver: any_member, non_author, maintainer (a maintainer of this profile), forbidden (no waiver), or n_approvals with a count of distinct non-authors.

n_approvals.description: How many distinct members who are not authors must approve.
